verdict.rationale: The official Proton Pass CLI is documented for scripted use across scripts and CI/CD pipelines. It can view, create, update, and delete items (including passwords, custom items, and SSH keys) and vaults, so an agent can store and update credentials programmatically. TOTP generation is documented only as an app feature for saved logins, not as something the CLI can write. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that TOTP secrets can be seeded via the CLI, in-depth reference docs beyond the announcement blog post, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven writes, and agent-friendly docs (llms.txt and markdown docs both return 404).
